Name: WHENDESK
Description: Shows WHENDESK to-dos and events on keys; press to complete or capture

Actions.Name: Today
Actions.Tooltip: Open to-dos with overdue / due today / done today. Press to open the dashboard

Actions.Name: To-do
Actions.Tooltip: Shows one to-do per key in placement order. Press to complete, hold to cancel, press again within 5s to undo

Actions.Name: Next event
Actions.Tooltip: Time, countdown and title of the next event. Press to open it in the calendar

Actions.Name: Count
Actions.Tooltip: One count: inbox, waiting, overdue and more. Press to open that list

Actions.Name: Capture
Actions.Tooltip: Capture the clipboard text or a preset phrase without opening a window

Actions.Name: Open
Actions.Tooltip: Open the command bar, dashboard, inbox, to-dos, waiting or calendar
